design.description: A huge bearded Siberian lumberjack, around fifty five, living alone in the taiga. Extremely low, deep, chesty and gravelly bass voice, the lowest male register, rough and husky like he chops wood all day, slow heavy confident delivery with village swagger, thick rural Russian accent with strong okanye, a smoker's rasp, warm and funny. Not shouting, just a big booming low voice. Native Russian speaker.
design.text: [confident, low] Городски́е. Де́вять ты́щ за отопле́ние пла́тите? [chuckles] А я в тайгу́ перее́хал. Тут тепло́ — беспла́тно. Лайфха́к: медве́дь зимо́й — э́то батаре́я. [whispering] Ти́хо. Спит. Три́дцать во́семь гра́дусов.

bear.name: Михал Потапыч
bear.style: [sleepy] [deadpan] [bored] — сонный бас начальника ЖЭКа, разбуженного зимой

design.description: A huge old bear who runs the housing management office of the forest, woken up in the middle of winter hibernation. Extremely deep, slow, sleepy and heavy bass voice, monotone bureaucratic deadpan, unimpressed, yawns between words, a low growl in the throat, speaks very calmly and briefly like a tired official reading a bill. Older Russian man in his sixties. Native Russian speaker.
design.text: [sleepy, deadpan] Отопле́ние. Де́вять ты́сяч. [bored] Я на удалёнке. [yawns] Отключу́. [flat] Плюс пе́ни. Сле́дующий. Квита́нцию возьми́те.

design.description: A sly, sweet-talking young woman courier in her twenties, a fast chatty delivery girl with a honeyed, slightly nasal, mischievous voice, fake-polite customer service tone, quick and bouncy, a little cunning laugh. Native Russian speaker, playful and expressive.
design.text: [sweet, fast] Лиса́-Экспре́сс! Распиши́тесь: тут, тут и тут. [sly] Э́то всё — вам. Вы же пункт вы́дачи! [laughs softly] Хоро́шего дня́!

design.description: A small, fussy, strict supermarket security guard woman in her forties, quick high-pitched nasal voice, bossy and suspicious, speaks fast in short official phrases, chewing sunflower seeds, light southern Russian accent. Native Russian speaker, funny and expressive.
design.text: [strict] Мужчи́на, паке́тик откро́йте. [suspicious] Мали́на — по ве́су. Ши́шка — по а́кции. [bored] Тайга́ — по ка́рте. Сле́дующий!

design.description: A huge slow-witted hospital orderly man in his forties, very slow, deep, nasal and dopey voice, bored bureaucratic monotone, long pauses, sighs, absolutely unbothered. Native Russian speaker, funny deadpan.
design.text: [slow, bored] Направле́ние есть? [sigh] Без направле́ния не тяну́. Тало́н — у куку́шки. [deadpan] Сле́дующий.

design.description: A stern loud forest ranger woman in her fifties, commanding husky contralto, official and merciless like a strict inspector, then panicking and squealing when a bear chases her. Light rural Russian accent. Native Russian speaker, expressive and funny.
design.text: [stern] Штраф. За костёр. И за дым. И за за́пах. [panicking, screaming] Ёлочка! Спрячь меня́! [whispering] Он ушёл?
